title: changing an existing settings file saves the old bytes first under .jitso/backups/<id>/, which ignores itself
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup hook, defect N-17): jitso registers its guard in the project's .claude/settings.json without clobbering anything
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-17, setup hook). Before it rewrites an existing file, jitso copies the old bytes to `.jitso/backups/<id>/.claude/settings.json` (`<id>` is the UTC time plus 4 hex digits), prints `backed up <path> to <backup path>`, writes `manifest.json` and a self-ignoring `.gitignore` (`*`) in `.jitso/backups/`. Since N-25 the guard also has a third PreToolUse group, `Write|Edit|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit`.
